newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize/soybeans lower on CBOT action.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize/soybeans lower on CBOT action.

text.p: Argentine cash maize and soybeans were trading lower Monday tracking losses in Chicago on a higher-than-expected grain stocks report, traders said.
Sunseeds prices also dropped influenced by soybeans and a soft oil market.
Volume traded was substantial as dealers sought to close end-of-month positions.
Wheat traded higher as local demand from millers and exporters picked up, traders said.
